parsed.explanation: Combined regime: no trans-specific criminalization; anti-discrimination and hate-crime law cover gender identity; severe anti-trans violence is prosecuted (2022 Pride shooter sentenced 30 years) and security service reports declining threats. Exposure is societal hostility: rising reports, low clearance, underreporting, online threats, far-right and media hostility. No documented traveler-facing border, facility or care restrictions, so unknowns are not penalized, but not treated as protections. Rule of law mitigates hostility, though routine harassment remedies uncertain. Adult-alone and minor risks: minor care exposure only if seeking gender-related care; guardian consent pathways may gate access; no documented visitor ban. Overall Reduced/Low borderline.

entry_documents.exposure: Not documented. No source on foreign passports, markers, border screening, device checks or hotel registration.
entry_documents.protection: Not documented. National anti-discrimination and hate-speech laws do not expressly document visitor entry handling.
entry_documents.interaction: Document mismatch could trigger checks, but no documented traveler-facing entry practice exists in the dossier.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Not documented. No trans-specific arrest, detention, prison-placement, interrogation or deportation practice reported.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: General rule of law: courts prosecuted Pride shooter and authorities investigate bias crimes; no evidence of custody targeting.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Custody risk appears incident-dependent; a detained traveler would rely on ordinary due process, not trans-specific safeguards.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Not documented. No sources address bathrooms, changing rooms, shelters, hospitals, sex-segregated venues or checkpoints.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Anti-discrimination law prohibits actual, assumed, former and future gender identity/expression discrimination in services and public gatherings.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Local enforcement not specified; capital police counts show bias-crime composition but not facility rules.

care_services.exposure: Not documented for visitors. Resident care has specialist gatekeeping, reports one-quarter approvals, nonbinary gaps and conflicting psychiatric-requirement signals.
care_services.protection: Official guideline says incongruence is not a disorder and care uses informed consent; discrimination protections apply to health services.
care_services.interaction: If a visitor or minor seeks HRT/continuity care, referral, guardian assessment or emergency placement could create friction.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: State does not frame trans people as a threat, but organized hostility exists among far-right, religious fundamentalists, some anti-trans feminist groups and tabloid media.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Prime minister condemns incitement against trans people; security service reports declining threats while warning Pride intimidation risk.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Hate-speech and hate-crime law create deterrence for serious conduct; everyday harassment remains underreported.

minors_guardians.exposure: No documented traveler rule targeting minors. A guardian seeking care for a trans child could face specialist assessment and limited approval.
minors_guardians.protection: Conversion-therapy ban; children’s directorate records decreasing hostility; anti-discrimination law protects identity/expression.
minors_guardians.interaction: Under-18 resident rules involve parental consent and national treatment service, which may affect care-seeking, not routine travel.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Hate-crime reports rose 18% in 2023; 2022 Pride mass shooting, knife attack and online threats are documented.
street_violence_police_response.protection: GI is included in hate-crime definitions; dedicated hate-crime group exists; serious offenders were prosecuted and sentenced harshly.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police clearance fell and many distrust reporting; routine street or online hostility may receive uneven visitor remediation.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Many anti-trans incidents go unreported; clearance dropped; fear of costs; border, facilities and visitor-care handling unknown.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Courts can punish bias crimes; discrimination/hate-speech statutes and security-service monitoring provide institutional recourse.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies work best for severe incidents; everyday friction may be undercounted and unaddressed.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar to Meridia because equality law, review institutions and low state detention risk apply. However, this dossier lacks documented traveler border facilities and has documented Pride violence and police trust problems, so routine safety is slightly less certain.

Close to Alderland: public harassment and attacks are treated as crimes and prosecuted. Our jurisdiction has a heavier documented hate-crime pattern but also organized security-service monitoring and strong sentencing, placing it broadly comparable.

Below Solmere because Solmere documents explicit facilities protections, trained transit staff, rapid venue remedies. Here visitor-facing facilities/borders are unknown, and severe anti-trans violence plus underreporting lower confidence despite broad legal acceptance.

parsed.synthesis: The operative regime is nationally protective: criminal law does not target trans people, gender identity is in hate-crime definitions, discrimination is unlawful, and severe anti-trans attacks attract major prosecution. Combined local records show no state-directed visitor exclusion and no documented border or facility bans. The residual risk is societal and online hostility, especially around Pride and gender-nonconforming visibility, amplified by underreporting, falling clearance and police-trust gaps. For an adult travelling alone, consequences if outed appear mostly harassment, discrimination or rare violence, with functional recourse for serious crimes. For an adult with a minor, risk rises only if care-seeking or school/service encounters activate gatekeeping; routine travel remains low. Uncertainty about visitor-facing entry and facilities prevents a higher score.
